decisions.reason: Finned tubes are a core, low-cost component of the firm's air cooler business, so keeping this option open costs little, even though the product disappearing from the website in 2020-2021 suggests it may be absorbed into the general offer.
Enhanced tubes still offer efficiency upside across the portfolio at low marginal cost, but their lack of visibility after 2019 and the firm's earlier pruning of A-D raise the chance of withdrawal.
